queryContract.scope: cCheckUnfairRoutineActive onExecute call to EnemyUtil.checkTargetCharaUnfair only; no identification with a stealth/surprise attack
queryContract.position: CharacterBase.get_GroundInfo().Pos if non-null; otherwise HunterCharacter.GameObject.Transform.Pos. Current native getters prove +0x110 is GroundInfo and +0xd0 is CharacterContextHolder; do not substitute reflected inherited offsets.

floatArguments: 10 if global current stage is ST405(13), else 3
firstQuery.attribute: AppVoxelData._NavNodeAttrArray[VOXEL_DATA._IndexNavNodeAttr], UInt64 bit10; used only for non-ANIMAL category

secondQuery.attribute: same lookup in the second returned DATA_INFO, UInt64 bit27

areaRelation.distanceSquared: float((dx*dx+dy*dy)+dz*dz), selected point minus hunter Transform.Pos; near iff strictly <0.25
areaRelation.near: not(valid self area in [0,255) and player merged-combat-area bit(self area & 63)) and (self area==17 or merged bit17)
areaRelation.far: EnemyManager.getAreaNoNearPoint(selected point,ST103)!=self area and (returned area==17 or self area==17)
areaRelation.bits: cCharacterContext.FieldAreaInfo._MergedAreaBit_EnemyCombatArea, UInt64; area17 shares the same bit in both reads

queryContract.referenceBoundary: When the selected point needs Transform.Pos, or the ST103 distance branch reads it, a missing GameObject/Transform calls error handler 0x46 and has no normal Boolean return. The formula retains an explicit unknown on exactly those branches. Other input query results refer only to normal native returns.
queryContract.unresolvedNames: The semantic editor labels of NavNodeAttrArray bit10 and bit27 are not established; keep their verified raw member/bit identities.

nodes.detail: 有效玩家及禁用标志、Stage/Area守卫通过后，按TARZAN_ATTACH动作属性、两次体素查询的实际返回和节点属性、ST103区域关系判断；真分支才写IsActiveUnfairRoutine=true。查询输入只表示具体查询的正常返回，缺失引用导致原生错误时不提供查询结果。
